name: PowerHouse 95 data center campus
summary: Campus aimed at hyperscale users, planned by PowerHouse Data Centers, a unit of American Real Estate Partners, along the I-95 corridor in Spotsylvania County, Virginia, through a joint venture with Harrison Street. PowerHouse completed the purchase of 145 acres in January 2024 and described an 800 MW campus served by three 300 MW substations, the first meant to deliver 150 MW. Its current campus page lists 227 acres, up to 900 MW of utility power, up to 12 buildings of up to two stories and about 3.6 million sq ft, with power delivery targeted for Q3 2027.

location.note: Sources say only that the campus is in Spotsylvania along the I-95 corridor near existing electrical infrastructure. The point is the Spotsylvania County coordinate from its Wikipedia article, not the site.

notes: Status rests on PowerHouse's undated living campus page, so status_as_of is the access date. The page's construction window starting Q2 2024 suggests site work may have begun, but no dated source confirming a construction start or a tenant could be opened, so the status is kept at announced. The 2024 reports describe the campus as aimed at hyperscale users in northern Virginia.
